# Data Source: identitynow_password_sync_group

Use this data source to look up a password sync group by ID or name. Lookups by name list all sync groups and match the name exactly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_password_sync_group" "ad_and_entra" {
  name = "AD and Entra ID"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Password sync group ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Name of the sync group. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `password_policy_id` (String) ID of the password policy of the sync group.
- `source_ids` (Set of String) Set of IDs of the sources in the sync group.
